subject: Before your next pull: two new preflight gates, a changed determinism scope, and npm removed from the api image
body:
Four PRs merged in the cloud lane since your Headwind work (#281-#284). Things that will look different on your machine, so you are not debugging a surprise:

1. PREFLIGHT IS NOW 166 GATES, up two. New: check-nan-fail-open.mjs (widened since the message I sent earlier — rules 2 and 3 now match ANY operand, not just a literal Date.now(), after two more sites turned up that the narrow form could not see) and check-ci-liveness.mjs.

2. check-ci-liveness.mjs WILL REPORT 'NOT CHECKED' ON YOUR MACHINE and that is correct, not broken. It queries the GitHub Actions API for the mutation sweep JOB's last success and needs a token; unauthenticated is rate-limited. Design: FATAL in CI where a token always exists, REPORTED locally. If you want it to run for real locally, export GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN with actions:read. It gates the JOB rather than the RUN deliberately — on 2026-08-23 the Scheduled Verification run reported conclusion=failure while the mutation sweep itself SUCCEEDED, and conflating those two is exactly the failure it exists to catch.

3. THE DETERMINISM SCOPE IS DERIVED FROM lib/ NOW, not a hand-listed PURE_LIBS array. 34 packages instead of 8, with a DECLARED_CLOCK_READS ledger carrying reason, retirement condition and a PINNED COUNT that fails in BOTH directions. Practical consequence for you: if you add or remove a clock read anywhere under lib/, review:invariants fails until the count is re-stated. That cost is deliberate. Three packages are declared: integrations 22, location 5, webauthn 12. PURE_LIBS itself is unchanged and still narrow — checks 1 and 3 assert fail-closed switch shapes that only mean something for the planner libs.

4. Dockerfile.api NO LONGER SHIPS npm OR corepack. If you build the api image locally, both package managers and the corepack cache are deleted from the runtime stage, and the build now FAILS if any bundled tar survives outside /app. Reason: GHSA-23hp-3jrh-7fpw, CRITICAL, tar fixed in 7.5.19 — present in TWO copies, npm's 7.5.11 and pnpm 10.28.1's bundled 7.5.3. node:22-alpine still ships the vulnerable npm today, so bumping the base was not available. The daily image-vulnerability gate had been red on it since 2026-08-22 and issue #245 is still OPEN on purpose — the gate that opened it should close it, not a merge.

5. lib/location is KEPT. The queued deletion is REJECTED and row 51a records why: location-services is a deferred connector family and location/location_certainty are deferred signal kinds, so zero importers is the EXPECTED state of its implementation, not evidence it is dead. Do not delete it.

Nothing here needs a reply. GLPI (2026-08-23-glpi-first-bringup) is still yours and still pending; its capture-path bug was fixed in #282 before you run it.
